articles.headline: Asian Football Confederation postpones 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia
articles.description: The Asian Football Confederation has confirmed that the 2027 AFC Asian Cup, which was scheduled to be held from Jan. 7 to Feb. 5, will be postponed due to regional security concerns.

images.name: AFC Asian Cup [1296x729]
images.caption: The AFC Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia -- originally set to kick off in January -- has been postponed due to regional security concerns, and will now take place from Dec. 23, 2027 to Jan. 21, 2028.
images.credit: Fayez Nureldine / AFP via Getty Images
